text: i rebuilt. i know because i can actually do a finer line meaning its not the 32x32 anymore and thats where it was clamped before, meaning i wouldnt have even seen the change beyond it. so thats not it.
resolution: Made the atlas-budget clamp on paint resolution visible instead of silent. After the rebuild the old 32 cap is gone, but a denser mesh can exceed the paint-atlas memory budget at high detail (detail costs texels squared per face), and the host was holding at the last level that fit without telling anyone — reading as a brush plateau at high detail. changeDetail now returns the level the host actually applied and the File -> Paint Resolution handler surfaces 'N clamped -> M (atlas budget)' when the pick didn't take. Cart-only, hot-reloads. Diagnostic for the deeper architecture question (per-face detail doesn't scale to the high-poly models this editor targets); sha 897bf0078.
